title: Sample satellite files at points or over areas

ports.note: Takes the places to read at, one kind of the three: points, a polygon layer, or a study area's units; and the files a search kept. Emits a long table: for points, one row per point per overpass or period; for areas, one row per area per period per satellite, with the cells counted.

ontology.note: Retired 2026-11-11. The modules that assert fw:SatellitePointSample and fw:SatelliteAreaSample are read by Sample a raster now, which declares their terms; this release emits nothing of its own.

implementation.note: Retired 2026-11-11. Its reading is Sample a raster's, from satellite files; what remains here is an archived definition, so a saved workflow naming the type can be migrated rather than refused.

changes.description: Retired into Sample a raster at points or over areas, whose other source is satellite files (experiment 205). The practitioner, 2026-11-11: "sample satellite files does not explicitly say it takes rasters that might be a problem"; then the name, "Sample a raster at points or over areas", and the design, the output follows the input. Retired outright, with no deprecation period, because nobody outside this project uses it (AGENTS.md). A workflow saved with one is migrated on opening to a Sample a raster step reading satellite files, its settings kept, stamped as migrated. Brazil dengue and New York ozone use it this way.

evidence.note: Lab check 35 holds the point reading of Sentinel-5P against h5py and pyproj (0.2.1). The area reading has unit tests, an offline browser test with three areas, and a run in Node over the 92 Rio de Janeiro municipalities against real MODIS files (experiment 180, M2); no lab check yet.
